$comment: Read by the dispatcher and the promotion step. On `pm-staging` the dispatcher merges checked application changes automatically. hubOwnerOnly is an automation boundary for CI execution configuration; it is not a request to hand-merge integration. The owner reviews application changes once, on the promotion PR into `staging`: every changed file under ownerOnlyPrefixes is listed under `## Look closely`, including application prompts. Preserve explicit custom hubOwnerOnly policy. guardTests encode an OWNER rule rather than a feature — the developer may not edit one to turn CI green, and every change or deletion is listed under `Tests changed or removed` in the promotion PR.
